steps.action: On the existing F-host run docs/chatgpt_status/topography/shards/height_difference_2/automation/030_apply_attempt_020_existing_f_runner_recovery.ps1 only. Preserve/start exactly one persistent canonical daemon; never create a second runner.
Verify the four recovery/output receipts, persistent_daemon_count_after=1, fresh heartbeat and exact task/attempt/continuation claim before canonical numeric work.

For each target point query the official EA National LIDAR and Time Stamped catalogue in native EPSG:27700. Record only exact intersecting returned filename/tile, flight start/end, spacing/resolution, transform, geoid, year/latest and survey identifiers.
Use an XML-capable client on the persistent Composite DTM 1m WCS 2.0.1 endpoint. Record the real CoverageId and DescribeCoverage response before GetCoverage; never guess an identifier.
Obtain the exact HMLR INSPIRE polygon from the current July 2026 monthly source and keep point-in-polygon/raster masking in native BNG EPSG:27700.
Retrieve real EA DTM1m raster bytes for each bounded HMLR polygon, exclude NoData, and compute only pixel-derived statistics inside the polygon.
Download real OS Terrain 50 archive members for TQ39, TQ59 and TQ27. Read per-tile BNG/ODN/flying-date metadata and sample documented 50m pixel centres as secondary crosschecks.

Run three EA/OS crosschecks, human-review provenance and verify port 8012 readback. Mark manual action RESOLVED only after F-host receipts, fresh heartbeat/claim and accepted outputs are remotely verified.
